Bloomberg’s Tim Stenovec breaks down why SpaceX is coming back down to Earth with a slightly lower valuation in its IPO. A trillion-dollar valuation needs trillion-dollar revenue assumptions to justify it — exactly the kind of stretch that defines late-cycle AI-capex froth. 影响: 万亿美元 IPO 申请是纯 AI 标的能触发的最大规模流动性事件，而在申请之后紧接着做自我修正，看起来是在为这轮募资管理市场叙事。万亿估值需要万亿级别的收入假设来支撑——这正是 AI capex 周期晚期泡沫化的典型特征。
